title: Caption-aware LiftClips (leave-gap cut)
aggregateCanonical: sha256 of sorted "digest  path\n" lines of sourceSha256
bounds: LiftClips (Cut) with captions no longer leaves a dangling clipLocal host as REF_NOT_FOUND. The admitted link-and-selection closure is lifted together; the vacated source stays a gap; a clipLocal cue bound to a lifted host becomes an absolute remnant at the same times with the same text; later cues are not shifted; absolute cues stay put.

A source-anchored cue whose host is lifted is whole-group ANCHOR_OUT_OF_RANGE, matching leave-gap DeleteClip uncover. Lifting a clipLocal-marker host remains an explicit whole-group REF_NOT_FOUND and is not rewritten as ANCHOR_OUT_OF_RANGE or converted to a remnant. Captions do not enter the internal clipboard package, so paste after cut does not copy or move them.

A real UI path imports AV, extracts persistent audio, splits, adds a clipLocal cue, uses Cut selection (LiftClips), undoes and redoes that command, archives a fork, exports a VTT sidecar, and still refuses preview/MP4 burn-in. The same persist path is also exercised with cutSelection through the SDK.

MoveClip / MoveClips, including insert-move leave-gap and includeLinks=false, is unchanged. Leave-gap and ripple DeleteClip / TrimClip stay as already delivered. The table 0.02s AV offset is off the 30 fps grid and still refuses OFF_FRAME_GRID; alignment stays 1/30 s.

Already-delivered leave-gap trim/delete, single-range ripple delete/close, shorten and lengthen RippleTrimClip, video-only and linked-audio TrimClip(ripple:true), DeleteClip(ripple:true) and leave-gap DeleteClip, caption-aware MoveClip, reject/overwrite/insert, includeLinks=false, insert-move leave-gap, caption default/follow/interval/source-window, split and leave-gap rebind/remnants, marker absolute default / clipLocal follow / ripple interval, 1000 seeded random undo, and the opened section-3 geometry matrix stay unchanged.
Not auto-close-on-move, new-track, cross-project bake, OS clipboard, I-006 roll/slip/slide, source-interval crop, field-aware inverse, marker sidecar formats, or the full section-3 matrix.
I-005 and I-010 remain partial; 87 count and XD10 stay separately counted. Intermittent underrun, old-writer schema9 as a product qualification, and other-end GPU physical sync remain unproven.
